notes.title: Active Pause Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Survivors!

Another year of siege has come to an end. Let’s welcome the New Year with an opportunity to get Siege Survival: Gloria Victis 75% off! The sale starts today, so don't miss your chance to defend the gates of Edring![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167140/Siege_Survival_Gloria_Victis/

[h3]Also, we took this chance to apply a quick update to the game, adding a feature requested many times by our Community: an active pause during the day phase!

Before now you could only slow down the game speed to 50% while in the castle. From now though, you can pause the game by clicking the slow-down button twice and still give orders to your survivors.

We hope you’ll like this change – let us know how it affects your gameplay![/h3]

notes.title: Community Update #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, survivors!

We are happy to present to you a new addition to the Siege Survival: Gloria Victis - the final iteration of Dynamic Events for both scenarios!

We heard your feedback, where you were pointing that it would be great to have some more diversity between each gameplay, and if the game would better react to your actions and needs. So we deliver!

Additionally, we are introducing two new challenges for the Lost Caravan scenario, as well as the New Game + mode for it. You can now try yourself in a race against time or survive the siege of caravanserai under the pressure of a never-ending sandstorm. NG+ gives you the same opportunities that we already have for the Siege of Edring scenario - you can adjust the gameplay to your liking!

The game, especially the second scenario, receives a lot of Quality of Life changes, which will enhance your experience, as well as some bug fixes and improvements, to ensure the best possible impressions from your time spent in the game.

Check the details below, and see you on the fortress's walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/baa3ee8da75a6eb7034b11910fc8b87bc4be194b.jpg[/img]
[i]Have you found the old battlefield already? There are tons of armanent there![/i]

[h2]Dynamic events[/h2]

[i]Dynamic Events[/i] is a system conjugated with the game autobalancer system, which is modifying the gameplay as you play and introduces more variety in the game, basing on various circumstances. From now on, in both scenarios, you may face events that will impact your gameplay.

The events will be shown from time to time at the beginning of the castle stage and will be based on your previous actions, choices, and status of your crew or Bastion. They can have a positive or negative impact, but can also add extra narration to the story, giving you even more insight into the events happening in your surrounding. They can also be used to forecast some changes in the game world like you were already able to see in the Lost Caravan scenario, where the system has been used to predict the beginning and end of the sandstorm.

We believe this fine addition will improve your feelings and add an extra layer to the playthroughs, creating a more coherent vision of the stories and gameplay. Be sure to leave your feedback on our Socials, Steam Hub, or reviews! We are thankful for your opinions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/92525c218034fc5eecee1208bfed33bb4aa7177d.jpg[/img]
[i]Example of one of the events you can now experience in the game.[/i]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[list]
[*]All characters in-game received short stories that will show at game summary, telling their further history after the siege.
[*]Added a new trader in the Lost Caravan scenario.
[*]Economy and difficulty balance tweaks for the Lost Caravan scenario.
[*]Added two new challenges and New Game + mode for the Lost Caravan Scenario
[*]Added Dynamic Events to both scenarios.
[*]New illustrations for various events.
[*]Improved the AI: guards are now walking instead of running toward the player when the time on scavenging ends.
[*]Improved guard's reaction to hearing a noise.
[*]Added a special sergeant guard in the Lost Caravan scenario which can drop some useful loot.[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue preventing the player from stopping fire of a passive crafting building (i.e. Garden Plot) after it was set aflame at the moment when the passive crafting was being prepared.
[*]Fixed an issue causing characters to meet themselves in events outside the castle in the Lost Caravan scenario.
[*]Fixed an issue causing some of the map markers were not working properly.
[*]Fixed all known issues causing cow carcasses to hang on the models of the buildings where they were impossible to remove.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the game summary screen was not counting everything correctly.
[*]Multiple spelling and color-coding fixes in text events.[/list]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Post release summary and roadmap for upcoming weeks!
notes.notes:
Greetings, survivors!

It's been a week since the release of Siege Survival and we are very happy to see that you like the game and see its potential. We can't express enough how happy we were to see the game reaching the top 6 in bestsellers this week and still holding on the top of the New and Trending Steam chart with a score of over 80% positive reviews!

It is heartwarming to see so many positive reviews praising the gameplay, unique setting, and bug-free experience, and we are honored that you found a place for us in your hearts!

We are reading all reviews, topics on forums, and messages sent to us through our socials. We see you like the game's mechanics and the story of Edring's Last Stand a lot. Also, the experienced players find it enjoyable to face the available Challenges and experiment with New Game Plus feature which lets you adjust your next gameplay even more. However, by reading your reviews it becomes clear to us that most of you would like to see more unique content in the game.

We are a small indie team that was always putting our Community first before anything else, and to be close with the Community is one of the most precious things for us. We are super thankful for your feedback! We are always here for you and we can assure you that we are working already and will work further on the game to introduce a lot of improvements and additional content. 

To make our pledge official, we are happy to share the post-release roadmap that will explain what is the plan for the upcoming weeks for Siege Survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/7b24cad3d910273f2a61061cc109efc11d44c444.png[/img]

[h3]Quality of Life and Editor Funcionality[/h3]

Later this very week, you can expect an update that will contain some more Quality of Life changes and improvements, including some ideas suggested by the Community (compass rose on the UI while scavenging!). We will also fix some small bugs with guards AI and balance the number of guards a little on the highest alert level.

In addition to that, we are continuing our work on Siege Editor - the complex tool that we used to create the "Edring's Last Stand" scenario and you can already use to make your own stories! As we are working on its documentation right now, we are still adding new features that will allow you to have more tools to differ your own creations. We also starting cooperation with some pro modders communities so you can expect to see their contribution and mod contests in the future. In the upcoming update, you will be able to access enemy creator to change the guard's stats, loot, and visuals, and animal room system, which will help you to set up the animal's needs and products.

[h3]Dynamic Events[/h3]

We know, that the castle gameplay is fun when it comes to the mechanics of building, crafting, and micromanaging your castle crew. But we also know, that the late stages of the game can become slightly repetitive and there is too little going on story-wise in the castle. We want to improve that by adding dynamic events, conjugated with our auto balancer system. Those events will be randomly generated and will happen in the morning or during the day in the day phase. They will provide some more storytelling and some more positive and negative modifications that will impact your gameplay. We hope those will be a great addition to the game and improve your experience.

[h3]New desert scenario[/h3]

As you clearly said as a Community, that you want more content, we will deliver. We are creating a new scenario for Siege Survival, titled "Lost caravan". Its action will take place in the far south, in dessert areas near the trade route between Sangmar Empire and the Central Sea which is imperial traders' main path for export and import goods with other nations. We will not spoil more details about the story yet, but we can say that the gameplay will be totally different and the goals you would need to achieve to win the scenario will also be different. We hope you will like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/7559b0fe00721e180baa3717ed5a73ddffbdabe4.jpg[/img]
[I]What a nice wide screenshot from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2495630120]Mr. Lucky Pants[/url]! Thank you for that capture![/i]


And this would be all for today. See you later this week and take care!
/ Siege Survival Team

notes.title: Small patch notes, and huge Thank you!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, survivors![/h3]

Thank you for playing Siege Survival: Gloria Victis and sharing your feedback and suggestions!
We are carefully reading your posts and reviews and we were able to address some of your feedback already.

Thank you for your honest reviews, kind words, and cheering for us. It is heartwarming to see so many and so positive reviews and also to see so many players playing our game. We cannot stress our gratitude enough for your support. We are also very happy to see the first community scenarios and modifications, especially the one that is extending the time of the day and night, and the one that is introducing alternative versions of the main scenario, with different nations used as attackers and defenders. It's entertaining and clever!

We are working hard in the background, fixing some small bugs and improving your experience, and yesterday we introduced some small fixes and improvements. We hope those will be warmly welcomed and we are already working on the next ones.

Cheers!

[h2]Hotfix 20.05.2021[/h2]

[h3]Quality of life:[/h3]

- Changed the color of "set for building" constructions highlight to cyan, to make it easier to differ the ready-to-build and currently placed buildings.
- Added 5 new Steam achievements to indicate unlocking additional gameplay modes and challenges
- Added a new tutorial: Time Management, to inform players better they can manage time in the game by slowing it down or speeding it up when it may be needed.
- Updated the tutorial graphics to show updated characters' portraits.
- Updated the title, description, and thumbnail of the Siege Survival Steam Workshop page.
- Rebalanced the Fodder crafting scheme, to allow creating it easier and from fewer resources

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

- Fixed the issue causing upgraded Butcher's table had a model of the armory.
- Fixed the issue causing loading day 1 led to animals being starving 
- Fixed the issue causing game summary could show wrong statistics

notes.title: Breaking news and a quick update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, survivors!

As we already know the exact date of the Siege Survival release, we cannot wait for the upcoming Tuesday, when you will be able to fully dive into the immersive experience we prepared for you and when you take control of besieged civilians on their last stand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/1efec03c0f508e6408536ee257394c31c1b131cf.png[/img]

The upcoming days is the best time to get back to the Prologue and ensure a headstart that will allow you to continue your gameplay in the full version of the game. After today's update, the saves from the  Demo and Prologue (both have the same content) will be fully compatible with the full game, so after release, you will be able to continue your journey without needing to start from square one. Pretty convenient, right?

It is absolutely worth checking the Demo version of the game one more time, since we made ALOT of user experience improvements, introduced many new features, and reworked some of the old ones following your suggestions and feedback. You will be positively surprised how the game evolved and how much better it is now, thanks to you and our team efforts.

We are very proud and thankful for your continuous support and cheering for us. As a small thanks and also as a little preview, we are happy to share with you one more track from our stunning Siege Survival soundtrack, created by the world-famous duo Marcin Przybyłowicz and Magdalena Ubrańska.

We hope this beautiful piece of music will sweeten the waiting through those few days that we need to wait until the release day.

Till then, stay safe!

notes.title: Siege Survival release date announced!
notes.notes:
Greetings, survivors!

After thousands of hours of hard work of the entire team and taking extra time to address your feedback and suggestions, we are pleased to announce that we can share the release date of Siege Survival: Gloria Victis.
 
We're on the very last straight, right now we are making the last polishing touches and focusing on the marketing of the game, to spread the word about the heroism of Edring people trapped behind the walls. They feel ready, we feel ready, the game is ready, and right now we should focus to ensure that everything will go smooth on the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37186745/fe63aa90181aa88df3817388a985fd174266ef04.png[/img]

We know that a lot of you are waiting for some time, and we are very thankful for your cheering and patience. We can finally reveal, that the siege will begin on [b]Tuesday, 18th of May[/b]. Less than three weeks from now!

Be sure to check the updated demo of the game, which includes almost all the changes and improvements we prepared in the last months, and to add the game to your wishlist. To please you during the last days of waiting, we are encouraging you to join our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1167140/view/2930115719580806391]Socials[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/HpyuumFRsD]Discord[/url], and check the newest [url=https://youtu.be/phcwvFyofuk]trailer[/url] and [url=https://youtu.be/XQRaFDWxwds]gameplay[/url] of the game.

Stay safe!
